option.description: ECharts option object. Accepts any valid ECharts configuration (series, axes, tooltip, legend, etc.).

theme.description: Theme name (built-in or gateway-managed) or inline theme JSON object.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Strip unsafe HTML from tooltip content.
